name: Dimensional Refactor
description: Esix warps the space around it in a burst of recursive energy. Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) force damage and is pulled 10 feet toward Esix. On a success, a creature takes half damage and is not moved.
